text.id: Sore. Gue pulang naik ojek, bau ikan, kulit leher kebakar matahari. Dinda nungguin di ruang tamu dengan dua gelas teh, satu tawar.
text.en: Late afternoon. I come home on a bike taxi, smelling of fish, the back of my neck sunburnt. Dinda is waiting in the living room with two glasses of tea, one without sugar.

text.id: Gue ceritain semuanya. Ibu-ibu kerang. Papan syahbandar. Kapalnya Pak Karta. Pak Hendra bilang nggak tahu Sekar di mana. Dari cara ngomongnya, gue malah yakin dia tahu.
text.en: I tell her everything. The mussel women. The harbor board. Pak Karta's boat. Pak Hendra, who doesn't know where Sekar is in a way that makes me sure he does.

text.id: Terus gue tunjukin foto CCTV-nya. Mobil hatchback, pintunya kebuka. Sekar turun.
text.en: Then I show her the CCTV still. A hatchback, its door open. Sekar getting out.
Bima's car is silver, Ka. A hatchback.
There are lots of silver cars in Jakarta.

text.id: Lo ngomong gitu karena lo percaya, atau karena lo pengen percaya?
text.en: Are you saying that because you believe it, or because you want to?

text.id: Gue nggak jawab. Kalau gue nggak jawab, Dinda tahu itu artinya apa. Semua orang di rumah ini tahu.
text.en: I don't answer. If I don't answer, Dinda knows what that means. Everyone in this house does.

text.id: HP Sekar geter di meja. Notifikasi dari nomor yang nggak disimpen. Pesannya panjang, rapi, pake huruf kapital di tempat yang bener.
text.en: Sekar's phone buzzes on the table. A notification from an unsaved number. The message is long and neat, with capital letters in all the right places.
